usage_rules.background_strategy: Always dark (#050505). Never use pure white backgrounds.
usage_rules.text_strategy: High contrast white/gray. Use text-shadow for 'glow' effects.
usage_rules.border_strategy: Visible, 1px or 2px solid borders. No soft shadows, use hard edges.

effects.usage: Hero headings, Active states, Key metrics

effects.name: CRT Flicker

effects.usage: Subtle animation on the main container

visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp corners (rounded-none). 2px solid borders for buttons and cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard shadows only (e.g., box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #333). No blur.

layout_strategies.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for the Studio and Dashboard. Asymmetric layouts.
layout_strategies.spacing: Generous padding (p-8, p-12). Use 'border-collapse' style for grids.
layout_strategies.containers: Window-like containers with a 'Title Bar' header (e.g., [ USER_STATS.EXE ]).

buttons.hover: Invert colors (bg-white text-black) + slight displacement (translate-x-1 translate-y-1).
buttons.classes: rounded-none border-2 border-white bg-black text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all duration-75 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest

inputs.style: Terminal input style. No background, bottom border or blinking cursor block.
inputs.classes: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-white/20 focus:border-white rounded-none font-mono placeholder:text-white/30 focus:ring-0

cards.style: Brutalist boxes. Black bg, White border.

modals.style: System Alert style. Centered, thick border, black overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'sonner'. Add the Google Fonts to index.html immediately.
2. THEME: Force Dark Mode. In 'tailwind.config.js', extend colors to use the specific hex codes provided in 'colors'. Override 'borderRadius' to 0px globally.
3. LAYOUT: Build the 'Gateway' page first. It must look like a secure terminal login. Use the 'Scanlines' effect globally.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove all rounded corners. Increase border thickness. Use 'Space Mono' for all UI text.
5. PIXELATION: For the image pixelation tool, use a client-side canvas approach. Do not upload images to server. Use a 'pixel size' slider.
6. GLOW: Apply the 'Text Glow' class to the 'Larrypixels' logo and key stats in the dashboard.
7. LEADERBOARD: Design it like a high-score arcade screen. Rank | User | Score.
8. ADMIN: The admin dashboard should look like a 'System Root' interface. Dense data, grid lines.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients. Use solid blacks and whites.
Do not use rounded corners. Everything must be sharp (0px radius).
Use 'uppercase' for all labels and headers.
Use 'sonner' for notifications (styled as system alerts).
